verdict.rationale: CRA's own EFILE channel lets certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers transmit returns system-to-system, which is a sanctioned non-interactive path (cra-supp-3, cra-docs-14, cra-docs-19). However, it covers only return filing, and only through vendor-certified software with EFILE number/password enrollment. Everything else (business registration, payments, documents) is described as interactive online portal use, and no agent-oriented docs exist (llms.txt is a soft 404). missing for 10: a public API or CLI usable headlessly by ordinary users, CI/scripting documentation, programmatic credentials beyond enrolled-filer logins, coverage beyond return transmission, and hands-on corroboration of automated use.
